description: Windows console utility for monitoring per-process disk I/O, process rankings, and ETW-attributed activity.
pre_install: if (-not $project) { throw 'DiskMonitor.csproj was not found in the pinned source archive.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "DiskMonitor source build failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $publish 'DiskMonitor.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'DiskMonitor.exe was not produced by the .NET publish step.' }
notes: The upstream repository publishes source only; this manifest pins a full Git commit and builds the Windows x64 application during installation. The upstream project version at this commit is 1.13.

The build uses the dotnet-sdk dependency and publishes a self-contained single-file executable inside the Scoop app directory. Native runtime files are extracted into the app's bundle directory, not the user TEMP directory. ETW-enhanced process attribution requires an elevated terminal.
The optional CSV activity log is stored as io_monitor.csv under Scoop's persist directory and is preserved across updates and uninstallation.
